package com.example.clinometer.garage

import android.app.DatePickerDialog
import android.content.Context
import android.os.Bundle
import android.widget.TextView
import android.widget.Toast
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity
import com.example.clinometer.Profile
import com.example.clinometer.R
import com.example.clinometer.applySystemBarsPaddingToRoot
import com.example.clinometer.data.GarageFuelEntry
import com.example.clinometer.data.GarageFuelEntryStorage
import com.example.clinometer.data.ProfileStorage
import com.example.clinometer.settings.LanguageManager
import com.google.android.material.button.MaterialButton
import com.google.android.material.switchmaterial.SwitchMaterial
import com.google.android.material.textfield.TextInputEditText
import com.google.android.material.textfield.TextInputLayout
import java.text.SimpleDateFormat
import java.util.Calendar
import java.util.Locale

class GarageFuelEntryActivity : AppCompatActivity() {

    private var profileId: Long = -1L
    private var currentProfile: Profile? = null

    private lateinit var btnBack: MaterialButton
    private lateinit var btnCancel: MaterialButton
    private lateinit var btnSave: MaterialButton
    private lateinit var tvVehicleName: TextView
    private lateinit var tvSubtitle: TextView
    private lateinit var tvProfileMeta: TextView
    private lateinit var inputDate: TextInputLayout
    private lateinit var inputLitres: TextInputLayout
    private lateinit var inputPricePerLitre: TextInputLayout
    private lateinit var inputTotalAmount: TextInputLayout
    private lateinit var inputOdometer: TextInputLayout
    private lateinit var etDate: TextInputEditText
    private lateinit var etStation: TextInputEditText
    private lateinit var etFuelType: TextInputEditText
    private lateinit var etLitres: TextInputEditText
    private lateinit var etPricePerLitre: TextInputEditText
    private lateinit var etTotalAmount: TextInputEditText
    private lateinit var etOdometer: TextInputEditText
    private lateinit var etNotes: TextInputEditText
    private lateinit var switchFullTank: SwitchMaterial

    private val selectedDate = Calendar.getInstance()
    private val dateFormatter by lazy {
        SimpleDateFormat("dd MMM yyyy", Locale.getDefault())
    }

    override fun attachBaseContext(newBase: Context) {
        super.attachBaseContext(LanguageManager.applyLanguage(newBase))
    }

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_garage_fuel_entry)
        applySystemBarsPaddingToRoot()

        profileId = intent.getLongExtra(EXTRA_PROFILE_ID, -1L)
        if (profileId == -1L) {
            finish()
            return
        }

        currentProfile = ProfileStorage.loadProfiles(this).find { it.id == profileId }
        if (currentProfile == null) {
            finish()
            return
        }

        bindViews()
        bindProfileInfo(currentProfile ?: return)
        setupDateInput()
        setupClickListeners()
        prefillDefaults()
    }

    private fun bindViews() {
        btnBack = findViewById(R.id.btnBackFromFuelEntry)
        btnCancel = findViewById(R.id.btnCancelFuelEntry)
        btnSave = findViewById(R.id.btnSaveFuelEntry)
        tvVehicleName = findViewById(R.id.tvFuelEntryVehicleName)
        tvSubtitle = findViewById(R.id.tvFuelEntrySubtitle)
        tvProfileMeta = findViewById(R.id.tvFuelEntryProfileMeta)
        inputDate = findViewById(R.id.inputFuelEntryDate)
        inputLitres = findViewById(R.id.inputFuelEntryLitres)
        inputPricePerLitre = findViewById(R.id.inputFuelEntryPricePerLitre)
        inputTotalAmount = findViewById(R.id.inputFuelEntryTotalAmount)
        inputOdometer = findViewById(R.id.inputFuelEntryOdometer)
        etDate = findViewById(R.id.etFuelEntryDate)
        etStation = findViewById(R.id.etFuelEntryStation)
        etFuelType = findViewById(R.id.etFuelEntryFuelType)
        etLitres = findViewById(R.id.etFuelEntryLitres)
        etPricePerLitre = findViewById(R.id.etFuelEntryPricePerLitre)
        etTotalAmount = findViewById(R.id.etFuelEntryTotalAmount)
        etOdometer = findViewById(R.id.etFuelEntryOdometer)
        etNotes = findViewById(R.id.etFuelEntryNotes)
        switchFullTank = findViewById(R.id.switchFuelEntryFullTank)
    }

    private fun bindProfileInfo(profile: Profile) {
        val displayName = getGarageDisplayName(profile)
        val vehicleTypeLabel = when (profile.vehicleType) {
            Profile.VehicleType.CAR -> getString(R.string.garage_vehicle_car)
            Profile.VehicleType.MOTORCYCLE -> getString(R.string.garage_vehicle_motorcycle)
        }

        tvVehicleName.text = displayName
        tvSubtitle.text = getString(R.string.garage_fuel_entry_subtitle, displayName)
        tvProfileMeta.text = getString(
            R.string.garage_fuel_entry_profile_meta,
            vehicleTypeLabel,
            GarageFuelEntryStorage.getCount(this, profile.id)
        )
    }

    private fun setupDateInput() {
        etDate.setOnClickListener { showDatePicker() }
        inputDate.setEndIconOnClickListener { showDatePicker() }
    }

    private fun setupClickListeners() {
        btnBack.setOnClickListener { finish() }
        btnCancel.setOnClickListener { finish() }
        btnSave.setOnClickListener { saveFuelEntry() }
    }

    private fun prefillDefaults() {
        etDate.setText(dateFormatter.format(selectedDate.time))
        etFuelType.setText(getString(R.string.garage_fuel_entry_fuel_type_default))
    }

    private fun showDatePicker() {
        DatePickerDialog(
            this,
            { _, year, month, dayOfMonth ->
                selectedDate.set(Calendar.YEAR, year)
                selectedDate.set(Calendar.MONTH, month)
                selectedDate.set(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, dayOfMonth)
                etDate.setText(dateFormatter.format(selectedDate.time))
                inputDate.error = null
            },
            selectedDate.get(Calendar.YEAR),
            selectedDate.get(Calendar.MONTH),
            selectedDate.get(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH)
        ).show()
    }

    private fun saveFuelEntry() {
        clearErrors()

        val date = etDate.text?.toString()?.trim().orEmpty()
        val station = etStation.text?.toString()?.trim().orEmpty()
        val fuelType = etFuelType.text?.toString()?.trim().orEmpty()
            .ifBlank { getString(R.string.garage_fuel_entry_fuel_type_default) }
        val litres = parseDecimal(etLitres.text?.toString())
        val pricePerLitre = parseDecimal(etPricePerLitre.text?.toString())
        val totalAmountInput = parseDecimal(etTotalAmount.text?.toString())
        val odometerKm = parseWholeNumber(etOdometer.text?.toString())
        val notes = etNotes.text?.toString()?.trim().orEmpty()

        var hasError = false

        if (date.isBlank()) {
            inputDate.error = getString(R.string.garage_fuel_entry_error_date)
            hasError = true
        }

        if (litres == null || litres <= 0.0) {
            inputLitres.error = getString(R.string.garage_fuel_entry_error_litres)
            hasError = true
        }

        if (odometerKm == null || odometerKm <= 0L) {
            inputOdometer.error = getString(R.string.garage_fuel_entry_error_odometer)
            hasError = true
        }

        val resolvedPricePerLitre = when {
            pricePerLitre != null && pricePerLitre > 0.0 -> pricePerLitre
            totalAmountInput != null && litres != null && litres > 0.0 -> totalAmountInput / litres
            else -> null
        }

        val resolvedTotalAmount = when {
            totalAmountInput != null && totalAmountInput > 0.0 -> totalAmountInput
            pricePerLitre != null && litres != null && litres > 0.0 -> pricePerLitre * litres
            else -> null
        }

        if (resolvedPricePerLitre == null || resolvedTotalAmount == null) {
            inputPricePerLitre.error = getString(R.string.garage_fuel_entry_error_amount)
            inputTotalAmount.error = getString(R.string.garage_fuel_entry_error_amount)
            hasError = true
        }

        if (hasError || litres == null || resolvedPricePerLitre == null || resolvedTotalAmount == null || odometerKm == null) {
            return
        }

        GarageFuelEntryStorage.addEntry(
            this,
            GarageFuelEntry(
                profileId = profileId,
                date = date,
                station = station,
                fuelType = fuelType,
                litres = litres,
                pricePerLitre = resolvedPricePerLitre,
                totalAmount = resolvedTotalAmount,
                odometerKm = odometerKm,
                isFullTank = switchFullTank.isChecked,
                notes = notes
            )
        )
        syncFuelLogCounter()

        Toast.makeText(this, getString(R.string.garage_fuel_entry_save_success), Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        finish()
    }

    private fun clearErrors() {
        inputDate.error = null
        inputLitres.error = null
        inputPricePerLitre.error = null
        inputTotalAmount.error = null
        inputOdometer.error = null
    }

    private fun parseDecimal(value: String?): Double? {
        return value
            ?.trim()
            ?.replace(',', '.')
            ?.takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() }
            ?.toDoubleOrNull()
    }

    private fun parseWholeNumber(value: String?): Long? {
        return value
            ?.trim()
            ?.replace(" ", "")
            ?.replace(",", "")
            ?.takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() }
            ?.toLongOrNull()
    }

    private fun syncFuelLogCounter() {
        val count = GarageFuelEntryStorage.getCount(this, profileId)
        getSharedPreferences(EXTRA_STATS_PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
            .edit()
            .putInt("profile_${profileId}_fuel_logs_count", count)
            .apply()
    }

    private fun getGarageDisplayName(profile: Profile): String {
        val prefs = getSharedPreferences("garage_display_names", Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
        val key = "profile_${profile.id}_display_name"
        return prefs.getString(key, null).orEmpty().ifBlank { profile.name }
    }

    companion object {
        const val EXTRA_PROFILE_ID = "PROFILE_ID"
        private const val EXTRA_STATS_PREFS = "garage_profile_extra_stats"
    }
}
